silhouette.reason: Low pebble hull, chevron prow, octagonal team-red turret roof and a long gun with a muzzle brake: reads as a light tank from every view. The turret is small and flat, and the side profile is a plain slab.
fixes: turret ~10% bigger and taller for RTS exaggeration
side skirts or stowage that break the long hull line

proportions.reason: 6.1 x 3.1 x 3.2 m with 0.6 m road wheels: inside the AFV-playbook light-tank range.
fixes: check the gun length (~0.6 of hull length) against the playbook light-tank range; it reads long

materials.reason: The bone paint is covered in dark elongated chip dashes that read as wood grain or birch bark, so the hull looks like painted wood; rubber tyres and track links read correctly.
fixes: rounder, edge-biased chips with lower density on large plates (a steel_painted variant with smaller chip scale)

detail.reason: Glacis spare links, weld seams, hatches, tool rack, jerry cans, grille, lamps, antenna; plates are otherwise flat, with no bolt rows visible at hero distance.
fixes: bolt rows on the turret roof edge and glacis
a tow cable on the rear plate

wear.reason: Chips everywhere and a little mud on the running gear; the chip pattern is uniform so it reads as texture rather than history.
fixes: heavier mud on the lower hull and wheels
soot streak down the rear plate visible from the 3/4 view

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 replaces the running gear with a solid belt slab and the road wheels vanish, so the side outline changes noticeably at RTS zoom.
fixes: keep 6 road-wheel discs per side at LOD2 (running.ts) inside an open belt

technical.reason: QA PASS (rebuilt today): 32.2k / 8.52k / 574 tris; 23 / 23 / 7 draws at LOD0/1 is heavy for an RTS unit.
fixes: merge static wheel pivots into fewer draws (one per side) since they spin together
